hooks.name: Fail if a property test was skipped or deleted
hooks.description: After a spec task is marked done, compare checker/tests/ and web/tests/ with HEAD and fail (exit 1) if any test was removed, newly skipped, xfailed, marked todo/only/fails, lost its @given, or lost fc.assert calls. The needs_model deselection is not a skip. If this fails, do not commit the task (commit-after-task) until it is fixed. Kiro has no 'before done' trigger, so this uses PostTaskExec.

action.command: cd checker && uv run python scripts/check_property_tests.py
